exposure: metabolically unhealthy with overweight or obesity (MUO)
metabolically healthy with overweight or obesity (MHO)
accelerated BMI z score growth rate between 6 and 24 months
finding: Early life factors, such as maternal obesity and accelerated BMI growth rate between 6 and 24 months, were related not only to metabolically healthy obesity but also to metabolically unhealthy obesity.
mod_finding: This study found that cesarean delivery was associated with metabolically healthy obesity in preschool children.
